content:
irene: Heads-up — after last night's role-matrix rollout (rm-rollout-2026-03-20) we're seeing privilege drift for a small cohort. Some users with 'viewer' role are getting edit affordances on Projects. Observed ~2026-03-20 22:02 UTC. Tagging sec/eng. :warning:

samir: repro steps?

irene: quick repro: log in as user attached to org X with role viewer_cohort_b -> open Project settings -> Edit button visible. API permission check returns can_edit: true.

irene: repro curl:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ \\n  https://console.internal/api/v1/projects/1234/permissions | jq .
# returns { "can_view": true, "can_edit": true } but expected can_edit false for viewer role
```

alex_k: saw this in telemetry too — spike in permission_grant events for role_alias "viewer_cohort_b" between 21:50-22:10 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/perm-events?rollout=rm-rollout-2026-03-20 :eyes: Trace prefix: trace-0x9f2

maria_s: did anything land in KMS yesterday? we did the alias remap (kms-alias-remap-2026-03-19) — could that affect derived permissions?

irene: checked KMS logs: decrypts successful; no immediate KMS errors. But audit entries for role_delta look unusual: role_delta shows [viewer -> editor] for a handful of binds.

sec-bot: ALERT: unusual_rbac_delta detected for org X (10 users), severity MEDIUM. See incident: https://incident.internal/IR-2026-2981

samir: mitigation options: 1) flip feature flag for rbac_v2_migration off (fast) 2) rollback rollout job (safer if config change) 3) UI gating: hide edit affordance by default unless explicit allow returned (quick UX patch)

alex_k: we have FF `rbac_v2_migration` at 35% canary. I can flip to 0% now. initiating...

ops-ci: rollback job started: rm-rollout-2026-03-20 -> rollback job id 6789 at 22:05 UTC. Notifying deploys.

maria_s: session tokens cache TTL is 15m; flipping FF won't evict active sessions. We should either force token refresh for affected orgs or add UI guard as stopgap.

irene: agreed. I'll create a short-lived UI guard: if permission lookup returns ambiguous OR role_delta present, hide edit + add telemetry tag. Patch in console canary channel.

samir: also need a backfill to recompute derived permissions for the last 24h and write explicit audit entries so customers can query. I can schedule a job: backfill-rbac-2026-03-20.

alex_k: PR opened for UI guard: https://git.internal/r/redwood/console/pull/4521 — includes telemetry event `ui_permission_ambiguous`. Adding e2e test to cover viewer/editor boundaries.

ops-ci: rollback complete at 22:07 UTC (rbac_v2_migration -> 0%). Monitoring metrics.

irene: current state: rollback done, UI guard applied to canary channel, backfill job queued (job id 7722). KMS audit continues; no decrypt failures.

maria_s: we should also rotate affected role aliases and run policy-sim locally against sample org X to validate. I'll run policy-sim and post results.

samir: action items (quick):
- flip FF -> done (alex_k)
- rollback rollout job -> done (ops-ci)
- deploy UI guard (irene) -> done (canary)
- schedule backfill -> queued (7722)
- KMS audit follow-up (maria_s) -> in progress
- revoke / force-refresh tokens for org X (security decision) -> pending

irene: will open incident ticket and postmortem template after backfill completes. For now, continue monitoring traces under prefix trace-0x9f2 and add 24h retention for those logs.

alex_k: monitoring shows error rate back to baseline but perm-events for the cohort still slightly elevated — could be cached clients. Keeping eyes on it. :eyes:

sec-bot: NOTE: audit log entries for role_delta added for 10 users (IDs redacted). Follow-up: attach logs to IR-2026-2981.

irene: final — rollback + guard in place, backfill queued. Moving to incident phase: triage -> remediation -> postmortem. If anyone sees a lingering edit affordance, ping me directly and include user id + org id. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
